title: At the Pharmacy
meta: B2 · 约 320 词 · 场景：药房买感冒药与用药咨询

lines.en: Hi there, what can I get for you today?
lines.zh: 你好，今天需要点什么？

lines.en: **I've had a sore throat and a blocked nose since yesterday. What would you recommend?**
lines.zh: 我从昨天开始嗓子疼、鼻子堵。你推荐吃点什么？

lines.en: Any fever or cough? And are you taking any other medication at the moment?
lines.zh: 有发烧或咳嗽吗？你现在有在吃别的药吗？

lines.en: No fever, just a bit of a dry cough. I'm not on anything else.
lines.zh: 不发烧，就是有点干咳。没在吃别的药。

lines.en: Then this day and night pack is a good option. The day tablets won't make you ==drowsy==, but the night ones will help you sleep.
lines.zh: 那这个日夜装挺合适。白天的片不会让你犯困，晚上的能帮你睡觉。

lines.en: Great. __How often should I take__ them, and __is it okay to__ take them on an empty stomach?
lines.zh: 好。多久吃一次？空腹吃可以吗？

lines.en: Two tablets every six hours, no more than four ==doses== a day. Better to take them after food.
lines.zh: 每六小时两片，一天不超过四次。最好饭后吃。

lines.en: Got it. Are there any ==side effects== I should watch out for?
lines.zh: 明白。有什么副作用需要注意吗？

lines.en: Some people get a dry mouth. Avoid alcohol, and if it's not better in five days, see a doctor.
lines.zh: 有些人会口干。别喝酒，五天还不好就去看医生。

lines.en: Makes sense. I'll also __grab some__ throat ==lozenges==. Which ones work best?
lines.zh: 有道理。我再拿点润喉糖。哪种效果最好？

lines.en: These honey and lemon ones are popular. That'll be eighteen fifty altogether.
lines.zh: 这款蜂蜜柠檬的卖得最好。一共十八块五。

lines.en: Hi, sorry, I was here this morning. I just remembered I have some ==paracetamol== at home for headaches.
lines.zh: 你好，不好意思，我早上来过。我刚想起来家里有扑热息痛，平时头疼吃的。

lines.en: **Can I take it together with the cold tablets you gave me?**
lines.zh: 它能和你给我的感冒药一起吃吗？

lines.en: Good thing you asked. These tablets already contain paracetamol, so please don't __double up__.
lines.zh: 幸好你问了。这个感冒药里已经含扑热息痛了，千万别重复吃。

lines.en: Oh, I had no idea. What happens if you take too much?
lines.zh: 哦，我完全不知道。吃多了会怎么样？

lines.en: It can damage your ==liver==, so stick to the dose on the box. Always check the ==ingredients== list.
lines.zh: 可能会伤肝，所以按盒子上的剂量吃。一定要看成分表。

lines.en: Thanks, that's really helpful. One more thing. My son's coughing too. Can he take the same thing?
lines.zh: 谢谢，太有用了。还有一件事，我儿子也在咳嗽。他能吃一样的药吗？

lines.en: How old is he?
lines.zh: 他几岁了？

lines.en: He just turned three.
lines.zh: 刚满三岁。

lines.en: Then no. Adult tablets aren't suitable for young kids. I'd suggest this children's cough ==syrup==, and the dose __depends on__ his weight.
lines.zh: 那不行。成人药片不适合小孩。我建议用这款儿童止咳糖浆，剂量要看他的体重。

lines.en: **Could you write the dose on the box for me, just so I don't get it wrong?**
lines.zh: 能帮我把剂量写在盒子上吗？免得我弄错。

lines.en: Sure. Five millilitres, three times a day. And if he gets a fever, __bring him to__ a GP.
lines.zh: 当然。每次五毫升，一天三次。要是他发烧了，就带他去看家庭医生。

gist.q: 「你」有什么症状？药剂师推荐了什么，怎么吃？
gist.a: 嗓子疼、鼻塞、有点干咳，不发烧；推荐日夜装感冒药，每六小时两片、一天最多四次、饭后吃。

gist.q: 「你」为什么又回到药房？药剂师提醒了什么？
gist.a: 想问家里的扑热息痛能不能和感冒药一起吃；药剂师说感冒药里已含扑热息痛，不能重复吃，否则伤肝。

gist.q: 孩子咳嗽，药剂师给了什么建议？
gist.a: 成人药不适合三岁孩子，改用儿童止咳糖浆，每次五毫升、一天三次；发烧就去看医生。

prompts.q: 你想买止痛药，但你最近在吃医生开的抗生素。用 30 秒跟药剂师说明情况，问清能不能一起吃、怎么吃。
prompts.ref: Hi, I need something for a headache, but I'm currently on antibiotics from my doctor. I finish them on Friday. Is it safe to take a painkiller at the same time? And should I take it with food, or does it matter? If there's anything I should avoid, please let me know.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我想买点治头疼的药，但我现在在吃医生开的抗生素，周五吃完。同时吃止痛药安全吗？要跟饭一起吃吗，还是无所谓？如果有什么需要避免的，请告诉我。

prompts.q: 孩子被蚊子咬得很痒，抓破了。你去药房问有什么适合小孩用的药膏，以及要不要看医生。
prompts.ref: Hi, my daughter is two, and she's got a lot of mosquito bites on her legs. She keeps scratching them, and a couple are a bit red now. Do you have a cream that's safe for toddlers? How many times a day can I put it on? And at what point should I take her to a doctor?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我女儿两岁，腿上被蚊子咬了很多包。她一直抓，有几个现在有点红。有没有适合幼儿用的药膏？一天能涂几次？到什么程度需要带她去看医生？

words.ex: This medicine might make you drowsy, so don't drive.
Take one dose in the morning and one at night.
The most common side effect is a mild headache.
Suck a lozenge slowly when your throat feels dry.

words.ex: We always keep some paracetamol in the first aid kit.
Too much alcohol is bad for your liver.
Check the ingredients if your child has any allergies.
Kids usually find cough syrup easier to take than tablets.
If you miss a dose, don't double up the next time.
